race.comment: HIT SQUAD (2) gets the nod. He's a lightly raced 5yo gelding who comes here off a let up having run well here over 1600m when last seen, beaten under a length in third. Back in trip off a freshen looks okay and he'll take plenty of catching. DOUBLET (1) resumes. He got over a bit further last time in but put up some good performances and wouldn't surprise. PEACE SEEKER (9) presents third up off two good runs, staying at 1200m at Ballarat Synthetic last time when just missing. Up in trip now looks ideal, go close. MACCA'S ANGEL (8) has been thereabouts her past couple over this route and is in the mix again.
